blocks.text: Pissikset or Pissis (singular), is a youth subculture based on teenage girls in Finland that emerged during the late 1990s to early 2010s and is related to the Fjortis and Mcbling aesthetic. It is centered heavily on hanging out in city centers or malls, outward appearance, and signaling status through trendy and maximalist accessories, frequently contrasted with male or alternative substyles such as fruittarit (trendy metrosexual boys), metalheads (Hevarit) or goths.
It describes the early noughties "bimbo/scene" trends elsewhere, characterized by heavy makeup, a distinct loud style, and a rebellious attitude.

The phenomenon of the subculture originated based on inspired satirical music, like the 2008 hit song "Pissikset" by the Finnish duo singers Lissut, and remains a main subject of the aesthetic on social media.

It features light/main orange tan, bold, heavy makeup (especially pale lips), straightened, curly or bleached blonde hair, low-waist jeans, tight branded clothing, and visible thong straps (stringit vilkkuen). Frequent use of heavy profanity, exaggerated words and early text messages combined with terms such as "raxu" (darling/friend) and "ihqdaa" (super cute).
